claims: An "extreme" immediate dispersal order in South Jersey was lifted on the evening of March 29, 2026.
The dispersal order followed a rowdy, large car/music event at Bridgeport Speedway in Swedesboro.
Residents across a wide area of South Jersey received a "confusing" mobile phone alert regarding the lifting of the dispersal order.
Police reported that the crowd was dispersed.
Police reported that the dispersal order was lifted.
Bridgeport Speedway is in Swedesboro, Gloucester County, NJ.
